s.note: the potato crop Mark grows in the Hab
s.how: Bake 800g large potatoes at 200C for an hour. Halve, scoop and brush with 40g butter. Fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake until crisp. Top with sour cream and chives. Grown with care.

s.note: the red dust and rock of Mars
s.how: Roast a red capsicum until black, peel and seed. Blitz with a tin of chickpeas, 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice and 1 tsp smoked paprika until smooth. Swirl with olive oil and serve with warm flatbread.

m.note: eating potatoes every sol to stay alive
m.how: Soften 2 leeks and an onion in 40g butter. Add 800g potatoes and 1.2L stock and simmer 25 minutes. Blend with 150ml cream until silky. Top with 150g crisp bacon and chives and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: the slingshot plan that brings him home
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses and pour over the fudge. Pipe whipped cream into a tall rocket shape and scatter crushed honeycomb at the base for flames.

d.n: Lewis's disco condensed milk iced coffee
d.note: the commander's disco music, all he's got
d.how: Brew 800ml strong coffee from 60g ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of four heatproof glasses. Pour 200ml hot coffee into each and stir until the condensed milk dissolves. Cool, then chill for 30 minutes. Add plenty of ice and top with a splash of cold milk. Stir once and serve with a straw.
